A0205.title: SaaS Application Permission Audit
A0205.description: Collects characteristics such as SaaS administrator accounts, OAuth grants, external sharing, and third-party application configurations, then applies rule matching, permission scoring, and baseline comparison to identify high-risk authorizations, excessive permissions, and anomalous external sharing.
A0205.definition: Inventory SaaS administrators, OAuth grants, external sharing, and third-party apps to identify high-risk authorization.
A0205.limitation: Attackers can bypass permission audits by leveraging legitimate OAuth tokens and long-standing unrevoked grants; frequent scope updates by SaaS vendors make baselines difficult to stabilize. High permissions required for normal business collaboration are prone to false positives and blocking, while blurred boundaries of third-party application authorizations generate significant noise.
